title: BAI Announces Advanced Coaches Course in Guwahati and Raipur
indian_angle: This course offers advanced training for Indian badminton coaches, enhancing coaching standards across the nation.
summary: Badminton Association of India (BAI) is organizing a Level-1 (Advanced) Coaches Course at the National Center of Excellence in Guwahati and Raipur from September 14 to 23, 2026, aiming to upskill domestic coaching talent.

title: New Regulations for Inter State Team Championships 2026 Released
indian_angle: These regulations govern a key domestic team championship, crucial for state associations and player development within India.
summary: The Badminton Association of India has released the official regulations for the upcoming Inter State Team Championships 2026, outlining rules and guidelines for participating teams and states.

title: Women's Doubles Pair Change for World Junior Championships Selection Trials
indian_angle: This directly impacts the composition of India's junior women's doubles team for a prestigious international event.
summary: An important notification regarding a change in the women's doubles pair for the selection trials of the VICTOR BWF World Junior Championships 2026 has been issued by BAI.

title: Junior Team Coaching Camp for Asia U17 & U15 Championships in Guwahati
indian_angle: This camp prepares India's promising young talent for significant continental junior championships, fostering future stars.
summary: A coaching camp for the Indian team participating in the Badminton Asia U17 & U15 Junior Championships 2026 is underway at the National Center of Excellence in Guwahati.

title: BAI Implements 3x15 Scoring System for Domestic Junior Events
indian_angle: This significant rule change will impact how junior domestic ranking tournaments and national championships are played across India.
summary: The Badminton Association of India has announced the implementation of the 3x15 scoring system for all domestic ranking tournaments and national championships in the U-13, U-15, and U-17 age groups.
